attention_sublayer_forward.step_4: self.self_attn_bda(attn_output_with_bias, residual, dropout) = bias_dropout_add = attn_output + bias + dropout(residual)

TE_FUSED_RESIDUAL_RMSNORM_EXACT_SEMANTIC.MakeExtraOutput: TE op that forks input as extra output of ops.Sequential. Treated as identity.

TARGET_B_CONTRACT.name: Cross-boundary bias_dropout_add + RMSNorm fusion

TARGET_B_CONTRACT.backward: dL/dx, dL/dw, dL/dbias, dL/dresidual, dropout backward
TARGET_B_CONTRACT.complexity: HIGH - crosses sublayer boundary, training/eval modes, RNG, dropout mask
